name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - Projet commun
title: REPORT on the joint text on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027 approved by the Conciliation Committee under the budgetary procedure
part_text:
The European Parliament and the Council have agreed the European Union's budget for 2027. Total spending commitments are set at about 199.7 billion euros, and actual payments at about 211.5 billion euros. The deal adds money for research, transport and energy networks, Erasmus student exchanges, humanitarian aid, border management, military mobility and the EU's public prosecutor's office. It cuts 50 million euros from the Recovery and Resilience Facility and 10 million from the planned EU centre on child sexual abuse. Parliament approved the agreed text, so the budget is now formally adopted.

- Extra money goes to Erasmus, research, transport, energy, humanitarian aid and border security.
- Cuts hit the Recovery and Resilience Facility, customs equipment and the child abuse centre.
- Parliament approved the deal, so the 2027 budget is adopted and will be published.
